title: Inspect and extend: Compose discovery, detail, and reusable poster views
objective: Use the real implementation in `Sources/Components.swift` to demonstrate and safely improve navigation, card poster rendering, shared store, and detail fields.
problem: SwiftUI composes reusable views around the selected movie. Follow the navigation value into the detail and understand which fields are present even when artwork is only a placeholder. Your implementation or debugging result must remain consistent with the source architecture.
requirements: Read `Sources/Components.swift` and the related project files: Sources/ContentView.swift; Sources/Components.swift; Sources/Screens/MovieDetailView.swift; Sources/Screens/DiscoverView.swift.
Add or improve a focused behavior related to navigation, card poster rendering, shared store, and detail fields.
Add a meaningful unit test or, when platform tooling is unavailable, document a reproducible manual check.
Update documentation to identify local, simulated, external, and missing behavior accurately.
constraints: Do not claim or implement as complete a capability outside this boundary: Poster URLs/assets may be absent; do not imply a live streaming/catalogue integration.
Do not add credentials, personal records, real funds, or unsafe public network exposure.
Keep the change within the existing project architecture and name any new dependencies.
expected_behavior: SwiftUI composes reusable views around the selected movie. Follow the navigation value into the detail and understand which fields are present even when artwork is only a placeholder.
acceptance_criteria: The implementation change is traceable to `Sources/Components.swift`.
Normal and failure/edge cases are described and tested.
The test outcome and environment are recorded honestly.
README or source comments correctly state remaining limitations.
hints: Read the caller and the closest existing test before editing.
Separate a pure rule test from any UI, device, provider, or network test.
